clips.title: The story
paras: In Thelsamar, Brock Stoneseeker sends an order for honorary mining picks to Ironforge. He asks you to enlist gryphon master Thorgrum Borrelson to carry it there.

In Thelsamar, Brock Stoneseeker trains new miners in rock composition and tunnel safety. The town depends on mining, and its dwarves take pride in the craft. Brock gives honorary picks to apprentices who distinguish themselves in training. Local supplies are limited, so the picks must come from Ironforge, across Khaz Modan.

Thelsamar's gryphon roost links the frontier to Ironforge through the kingdom's aerial courier network. Gryphon master Thorgrum Borrelson tends the roost beside town. Brock asks you to bring his order to Thorgrum, who can arrange a swift courier run to the capital and its foundries.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I see a lot of young dwarves at my door, eager to learn the trade of mining. And if there's one thing a miner needs more than anything, it's a pick!
I have a list of mining students who scored high in their lessons and earned an honorary pick. Take my list to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge. He'll get the picks ready.
The fastest way to Ironforge is on a gryphon, so bring the list to our gryphon master, Thorgrum Borrelson, and speak with him about transport to Ironforge.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you had your fill of Thelsamar so soon? Are you ready to leave for another city?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have to get this to Ironforge, eh? For a small fee I can put you on the back of one of my gryphons, and it'll take you there. How does that sound?
